name: Kuryuu Mashiro
source:
Mashiro Kuryu serves as the face of Gekka where Alicetia can't and keeps Ainoshima's flowerbeds well watered. A somewhat sheltered girl who cares dearly for her friends, she might prove surprisingly assertive in the pursuit of something—or somebody—she wants.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/shiravune/status/1421221244016283649]Shiravune[/url]]

Class: 1-D

Gekka-kai's vice president. Her hobbies include taking care of flowers, as she takes care of the school's backyard's flowers.
